title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising-
overview: After the events of Rebellion, the world appears to be in balance—but that peace is fragile. As a new threat connected to Walpurgisnacht emerges, Homura Akemi is forced to face the consequences of her choices and question how far she is willing to go to protect Madoka.

title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
overview: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

title: Digger
overview: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

title: Verity
overview: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.

title: Spa Weekend
overview: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.

title: Santiago
overview: At his grandmother's request, Santiago goes to the cinema in search of the man from whom he inherited his name, a Brazilian actor who passed away in the 1950s but who, on this night, will be brought back to life on the movie screen.

title: The Quiet Hour
overview: On a winter afternoon, with a storm about to break, Dani follows her cousins ​​Nora and Inés to a cube-shaped shelter in the middle of the woods. There, they perform a ritual to hold back the rain and save their friend—"the Presence." Dani must follow a set of rules for the ritual to succeed, but the moment Nora sacrifices an earthworm, she can no longer bear it and breaks the cardinal rule: never leave the cube.

title: Not Only Dogs Lick
overview: In a quiet house, Leonor spends her days in near-constant solitude, while her mother, Diana, works tirelessly around the clock to support them. One night, after a terrifying experience in her room, Diana tries to comfort her by giving her a puppy, hoping its companionship will help her sleep peacefully. At first, the dog becomes her refuge and inseparable companion. But when the shadows begin to move again and the strange noises return, Leonor will discover that not everything that licks her hand in the dark is her pet.

title: Betty
overview: Upon discovering her grandmother Betty’s poems, Oriana attempts to piece together her image in order to understand her own identity. Delving into her family’s past, she reflects on legacy, family, and absence. What remains of us when we leave?

title: On the Other Side of the Bridge are the Things I Never Said
overview: After years apart, Mora reconnects with Luna—the great, unconfessed love of her youth—hoping to rekindle the friendship they once shared. During dinner, Luna reveals she had secretly been in love with her; this long-held silence brings to the surface buried feelings and questions about what might have been.

title: Operation 29
overview: In a dystopian reality where homemade food is banned and nutrition comes solely from pills, five older women gather to make gnocchi in absolute secrecy.

title: Upside Down
overview: After the loss of his most beloved, Ku the rabbit must face a new reality—literally turned upside down—accompanied by a magical being that will help him navigate his grief and the coldest winter of his life.

title: Cockroach
overview: During a doctor's visit, two siblings debate how to handle the care their mother needs. Their respective personal circumstances lead them to make a decision that reveals their true nature.

title: Gaspi: Camino a la Velada
overview: Gaspi flees the city, but he cannot escape his destiny. He agrees to take part in a boxing match solely for the money, placing himself at the mercy of his new trainer, Sergio Bara. Together, they will experience moments that are funny, bizarre, and dreamlike, guided by a single motto: “Hit… and don’t get hit.”

title: Hope
overview: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

title: By Any Means
overview: In 1960s Mississippi, a young Black FBI agent is forced to partner with a notorious mafia hitman to investigate a wave of brutal civil rights murders.

title: Life Is Life
overview: An elderly shepherd takes on big business when he becomes the only holdout against property developers building a luxury resort in his tiny Sardinian village.

title: Other Mommy
overview: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

title: La casa
overview: After many years working for a multinational company, Hugo Vaca is laid off and must face the harsh reality of the job market. On the verge of despair, he connects through a friend with a group of investors who offer to buy his house, valued at one million dollars, at 50 percent of its value, but with usufruct rights until his death. Cornered by reality, he accepts the deal, but things end up becoming much more complicated than he expected.

title: Blue Lock
overview: A secret training program is established by the Japan Football Union to scout the world’s greatest striker after several years of defeat for the national team. Three hundred high school players gather at a remote facility to compete in ruthless trials where only one will emerge as the world’s greatest and most egoistic striker. The price of failure is absolute: those eliminated are permanently banned from ever joining the National Team.

title: Always Lalisa
overview: Documentary following global superstar LISA during a transformative year away from BLACKPINK, the K-pop phenomenon that made her one of the world's most recognizable performers. Documenting a year of risk, reinvention, and self-discovery as LISA begins to define her next chapter.

title: Street Fighter
overview: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

title: Whalefall
overview: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

title: I Want Your Sex
overview: When a naive young man becomes the sexual muse for a renowned and provocative artist, his dream job quickly turns dangerous as he is drawn into an obsessive world of power, betrayal, and murder.

title: Just an Illusion
overview: In 1985 suburban Paris, 12-year-old Vincent lives with his distant older brother and quarrelling parents. Amid laughter and unease, he navigates friendship and first love, while beginning to confront the adult world.

title: Monster Mia
overview: 12-year-old Mia and her scruffy pet rat Quentin are sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy after one too many problems at school. The new school gives her the creeps, and Mia needs to figure a way out before the students realize she isn't a monster like them! But the vice principal Van Vlad hosts a particular dislike for humans, and Mia is scared he has seen through her act...

title: Beware Boiúna
overview: Deep in the Amazon, a medical mission spirals into a fight for survival when Boiúna, a colossal ancient predator, awakens to reclaim her domain. In the jungle where nature holds absolute power, she decides who lives and who dies.

title: The Social Reckoning
overview: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

title: Clayface
overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

title: God Forgives Everyone
overview: Arturo is a lonely, gluttonous, and disillusioned Sicilian real estate agent. His mundane life finally finds its spark through his one true passion: Sicilian pastries. It’s over a tray of cannoli that he meets his soulmate, Flora. She is everything he ever dreamed of—beautiful, witty, and brilliant. To top it off, she’s a pastry chef.  However, a divine obstacle stands between them: God.  While Flora is a devout, fervent Catholic, Arturo abandoned his faith as a child. Desperate not to lose the woman of his dreams, he decides to "fake it 'til he makes it," pretending to be a man of deep conviction. Guiding Arturo on this chaotic journey toward truth, faith, and Flora’s heart is an unlikely mentor and friend: Pope Francis himself.

title: Good Vibes Only
overview: Based on the true story of a married couple who invented a groundbreaking sex toy heralded as forever changing the way women experience pleasure.

title: TOMORROW X TOGETHER WORLD TOUR 'ACT : TOMORROW'
overview: Like shining stars, TOMORROW X TOGETHER’s fourth world tour 'ACT : TOMORROW' unfolds as a dazzling journey toward the tomorrow they promised together. From its beautiful storytelling to the stunning production and powerful live performances that captivated MOA around the world, experience the immersive energy of TOMORROW X TOGETHER’s spectacular world tour on the big screen!

title: SEVENTEEN WORLD TOUR 'NEW_'
overview: Celebrating their 10th debut anniversary, SEVENTEEN embarks on a world tour fueled by their determination for a fresh start, just like the title 'NEW_'. With their unrivaled stage presence and explosive energy, SEVENTEEN once again proves their unlimited potential. Experience the blazing heat of the concert—bursting with each member’s unique charm—right on the big screen!

title: HYBE CHEERING PARTY
overview: The heat of cheering for HYBE artists unfolds in cinemas! Sing along with your favorite HYBE Artists in 3D! A one-of-a-kind game-like cheering screening is coming, where fans can chant fan cheers and wave their light sticks while watching the music videos of BTS, SEVENTEEN, TOMORROW X TOGETHER, ENHYPEN, LE SSERAFIM, &TEAM, BOYNEXTDOOR, TWS, ILLIT, KATSEYE, aoen, CORTIS, and SANTOS BRAVOS on the big screen. Join this unforgettable celebration filled with diverse music, passionate fan energy, and a dazzling wave of Light Sticks!

title: Wildwood
overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

title: Pinocchio: Unstrung
overview: Influenced by a sinister Cricket and created by Geppetto, Pinocchio launches a violent crusade to carve himself into a real boy like his brother James, one piece at a time.

title: Fatherland
overview: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

title: Lockbox
overview: A woman puts her life on the line to protect her troubled and enigmatic cousin, who has been targeted and hunted by a powerful supernatural force.

title: Sense and Sensibility
overview: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

title: Everest: The Other Side
overview: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest—the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth—something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.
